review.en: A frame tale in which a woman keeps herself alive by never finishing a story, and inside it tales of merchants, jinn, thieves and caliphs that open into further tales. The collection grew over centuries and its contents vary from manuscript to translation. Uneven as it is, its idea of storytelling as a way of postponing death has never worn out.
review.zh: 一个框架故事：女子靠永远讲不完故事来保住性命；故事里又有商人、精灵、盗贼和哈里发，一层套一层。这部集子历经数百年才成形，各个抄本与译本收录的内容也不尽相同。它参差不齐，但“以讲述延缓死亡”这个想法从未过时。
